name: kn-sanctions-checker
description: Mock MCP server exposing a single tool: check a counterparty (carrier, vessel, consignee, port) against consolidated sanctions lists (EU, OFAC, UK HMT, UN). For the Lane Risk Sentinel demo only - returns deterministic mock results.

tools.name: check_counterparty
tools.title: Check counterparty against sanctions lists
tools.description: Returns CLEAR / FLAGGED / BLOCKED for a given counterparty across EU, OFAC, UK HMT and UN consolidated lists. The agent must call this for any rerouted shipment before sending a proposal.

name.description: Name or identifier of the entity

carrier_Maersk_clear.evidence: No match in EU, OFAC, UK HMT, UN consolidated lists.

carrier_demo_flagged.evidence: Name similarity to listed entity (62%). Manual review required.

demoNotes: For the live demo, all Contoso lanes return CLEAR. Switch the agent into 'sanctions exception' mode (Topic: Test_Sanctions_Flagged) to demonstrate the FLAGGED response path during Q&A.
